    Profile

    Sieba is a young woman who is known as the Veda Templar's "Number Seven." Her feelings towards Yauras, who once saved her life, are complicated, and she's aware of these feelings herself, too. She loves all things dazzling and gorgeous, and collects beautiful objects—to her despair, though, she has an allergy to roses.

    Origin: Lost Blue
    Gender: Female
    Height: 167cm
    Weight: 57kg
    Birthday: Jul 20
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Shimmering Dragon
    Likes: Beautiful things (except roses)
    Hobbies: Making herself look beautiful
    Illust: だーくろ
    CV: 葉山いくみ
